name: 🍎 Eggs & Apple Slices
what: Hard-boiled eggs and crisp apple slices.
early: Optional, Sunday: boil a dozen eggs; unpeeled, they keep a week.
extras: peanut butter or cheddar for dipping, lemon, everything seasoning

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Water on to boil.
Lower cold eggs into the boiling water with a spoon.
Into ice water, then peel under the tap.
Slice apples, squeeze of lemon. Halve eggs, salt and pepper.

key: Start eggs in boiling water, not cold, and they peel easily.
done: Yolks are set but still creamy.
plan_b: Already-boiled eggs in the fridge? Skip to the last step.
